snippet.title: Ancient Egypt Discoveries Documentary - Why We Still Can't Figure Out the Egyptians
snippet.description: Let's look at the most puzzling Ancient Egypt mysteries that archaeologists and scholars still haven't been able to solve, even thousands of years later. From lost labyrinths to enormous unfinished obelisks, stone masonry with exceptional precision, mysterious figurines, and Saqqara's granite boxes.  The ancient Egyptian civilization has captured the imagination of many people in different times and from different philosophical viewpoints and some fantastic claims have been made regarding their origins and the extent of their knowledge.

snippet.description:

snippet.title: 🔴 Live: Shark Rivalries | SHARKFEST 2026 LIVESTREAM | National Geographic
snippet.description:
Celebrate Sharkfest 2026 with this National Geographic livestream featuring 12 full episodes of the wildest shark battles! Dive underneath the waves to learn more about some of the ocean's top predators and how their unique adaptabilities help them reach the top of the food chain. 

Featured topics include:
-Great White Sharks
-Tiger Sharks
-Bull Sharks
-Hammerhead Sharks
-Orca
-Interviews with Shark Experts
-Dolphins
-Tuna
-Sharks Around the Globe

Episodes included in this livestream are: 

Great White vs. Tiger Shark
Up close and personal with some of the largest great whites and tiger sharks ever recorded, including the famed great white Deep Blue.

Bull Shark vs. Hammerhead
Shark experts launch an investigation into bull sharks and great hammerheads after a rare video is discovered that shows them going head-to-head. 

Orca vs. Great White
Researchers in New Zealand dive with great white sharks, in an attempt to discover if they are being hunted and eaten by killer whales.

Sharks vs. Dolphins: Blood Battle
Sharks and Dolphins have shared the ocean for millennia, but scientists have only just begun to understand the complex relationship between sharks and dolphins.

Sharks vs. Dolphins: Bahamas Battleground
In The Bahamas, more than 30 percent of dolphins have shark bite scars. Dr. Mike Heithaus and Dr. Valeria Paz investigate which sharks are attackings.

Jaws vs. Boats
Viral videos of sharks attacking boats abound. Dr. Mike Heithaus and PHD Candidate Sara Casareto investigate what’s causing this clash.

Shark vs. Tuna
Witness a clash of oceanic titans in the crystal-blue battlefields of Ascension Island. 

Sharks vs. the World
Take a deep dive into the tumultuous life of sharks as surfers, scientists, sea lions… even whales go head-to-head with the oceans’ ultimate predator!

Man vs. Shark
Marine biologist and shark suit inventor, Jeremiah Sullivan, attempts to intentionally get bitten by a deadly tiger shark and survive. 

Shark vs. Predator
Home video and photographs captured by tourists and fisherman reveal the rare moments when a shark ends up on the receiving end of an attack. It’s time for nature’s ultimate underwater showdown. 

Shark vs. Whale
Marine biologist Ryan Johnson discovers rare behavior of a whale attacking a great white. 

Killer Shark vs. Killer Whale
Sharks and Dolphins have shared the ocean for millennia, but scientists have only just begun to understand the complex relationship between sharks and dolphins.

snippet.title: The Ancient Amazon: Evidence That a Massive Civilization Existed in the Rainforest
snippet.description:
In 1541, Spanish conquistador Francisco de Orellana entered the Amazon searching for food, but what he discovered may have been one of the greatest lost civilizations in human history.

Ancient cities hidden beneath the rainforest. Massive road networks. Engineered soil that remained fertile for thousands of years. And millions of people living in a civilization the modern world believed never existed.

Using archaeological discoveries, LIDAR scans, forgotten journals, and modern research, this documentary explores the shocking evidence that the Amazon rainforest was once home to a vast and sophisticated civilization erased by time, disease, and the jungle itself.

What if the greatest lost civilization on Earth was hidden in the Amazon all along?

snippet.title: Methuselah's Secret and Why Ancient Humans Once Lived for 900 Years
snippet.description:
The Bible records that Methuselah lived for 969 years. Adam lived for 930. Noah was 600 when the flood came. Modern science dismisses these numbers as mythology, but researchers in multiple fields are finding reasons to take them seriously. Ancient Sumerian king lists record rulers with reigns of thousands of years before the flood, dropping to human-scale after it. Genetic scientists have identified a cluster of genes associated with extreme longevity that appear to have been deactivated in the human genome at some point in prehistory. What happened? And who turned off our ability to live for centuries?

snippet.title: The Mother Civilization: The Place Where Man First Appeared
snippet.description:
Long before the rise of civilizations like Sumer, Egypt, or the Indus Valley, there are records, legends, and oral traditions that speak of a lost continent known as Mu.

Said to have existed over 50,000 years ago, Mu was a vast landmass stretching across the Pacific Ocean, larger than South America, and home to millions. According to these accounts, it was a highly advanced civilization, with knowledge and technologies that still remain unexplained today. Some theories go even further, suggesting that Mu’s origins may not have been entirely human.

Ancient cultures separated by vast oceans seem to remember the same story: a powerful civilization that disappeared in a cataclysm, leaving behind fragments of its knowledge, symbols, and possibly even its bloodlines.

But what most people don't know is what daily life in the lost civilization of Mu actually looked like.

By exploring Mu through archaeology, cross-cultural myths, and emerging theories, we open a window into a time before history and perhaps into the true origins of human civilization itself.

snippet.title: Ellora Caves Documentary 2019 The Mind-Boggling Rock Cut Temples of India
snippet.description:
Everyone is trying to understand how the Ellora caves were built, cut out of the rocks, without the use of ‘modern’ technology it is a 
construction that we would be hard pressed to replicate today. This new, never before seen documentary will look closely at this intricate temple and suggest—as have many archaeologists—that thousands of years ago, ancient cultures were far more advanced than some scholars are crediting them for. What baffles experts is their incredible precision and design. It seems very plausible that whoever built these fascinating cave may have been using an unknown advanced ancient technology. Cave 16, the magnificent Kailasa Temple, and is notable for being the largest monolithic structure in the world that was carved out of a single piece of rock!
